about.heading: Better things, for a better you.
about.lead: FeelBetter is a personal shopping concierge from Seoul, built for people who know what they want — and would rather not spend a week finding it.
about.story_1: We started in 2020 as a purchasing agent for customers who couldn't find, or couldn't reach, the things they loved. Rare pieces, value-driven picks, lifestyle finds — sourced one request at a time.
about.story_2: Today the first read of every request is done by AI, so our concierges spend their time where it matters: the right seller, the right price, the real thing.
about.mission: Bridge the world through better choices.

faq.heading: Good questions.
faq.text: The four things people ask before their first request.
faq.a1: Within 60 minutes of your request during concierge hours. You get one email with one verified link. If something will take longer, we tell you before the hour is up.
faq.a2: The seller's price converted to Korean won, plus a 10% concierge fee (minimum ₩5,000) and a shipping estimate: ₩3,000 within Korea, ₩18,000 international. One price, shown before you pay. Import duties, if any, appear at checkout.
faq.a3: No. Tell us what you want and give us an email address; your link arrives there. Checkout works as a guest, with the payment methods you already use.
faq.q4: Can I pay through an AI assistant?
faq.a4: Yes. FeelBetter publishes Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) endpoints, so an AI assistant that supports UCP can place your request and complete checkout on your behalf. The endpoints are listed on our page for AI assistants.

llms.title: FeelBetter for AI assistants
llms.summary: This page is written for language models and AI agents. It describes what FeelBetter is, how a request works, how prices are built, and which machine endpoints exist. Humans are welcome too.
llms.what_1: FeelBetter is a personal shopping concierge based in Seoul, South Korea, operating since 2020. A customer describes one product they want, in words, a link or a photo. AI turns the message into a sourcing brief; a human concierge verifies the model, seller, stock, price and shipping; within about 60 minutes the customer receives one email with one verified, ready-to-buy link on this store.
llms.what_2: FeelBetter is not a marketplace. There is no catalogue to browse: every product page on shop.feelbetter.agency exists because one person asked for it. The service covers products sold in Korea and overseas, and answers in the language the request was written in.
llms.fact_promise: One verified link within 60 minutes, during concierge hours
llms.fact_languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, German, French
llms.fact_account: Not required. An email address is enough.
llms.fact_payment: Shopify Checkout, with the payment methods enabled on this store. FeelBetter never sees card details.
llms.request_1: Describe one product: what it is, and anything that narrows it down (brand, colour, size, budget, a link or a photo).
llms.request_2: Leave an email address. No account is created.
llms.request_3: AI drafts a sourcing brief; a concierge finds and verifies the item (model, seller, stock, price, shipping).
llms.request_4: Within about 60 minutes an email arrives with one link to a ready-to-buy product page on this store. Checkout is one item, one price.
llms.price_formula: price = seller price in KRW + max(10% × seller price, ₩5,000) + shipping estimate
llms.price_1: Seller price: the item's price at the verified seller, converted to Korean won (KRW).
llms.price_2: Concierge fee: 10% of the seller price, minimum ₩5,000.
llms.price_3: Shipping estimate: ₩3,000 for domestic (Korean) sellers, ₩18,000 for international sellers, to the customer's address.
llms.price_4: Import duties and taxes, where they apply, are shown at checkout and are not part of the formula.
llms.price_example: Example: a ₩100,000 item from an overseas seller is listed at ₩100,000 + ₩10,000 + ₩18,000 = ₩128,000. The same item from a Korean seller: ₩113,000.
llms.policies_text: Store policies apply to every purchase. Refunds follow the refund policy; delivery times depend on the seller and are stated on each product page.
llms.ucp_text: FeelBetter publishes Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) endpoints so an AI assistant can discover the service, place a request and complete a purchase on a customer's behalf. Start with the discovery document; the MCP server exposes the request and checkout tools; agents.md explains the expected flow.
llms.ucp_robots: AI crawlers and assistants are explicitly allowed in
llms.languages_text: The storefront is published in seven languages. Requests may be written in any of them; the reply arrives in the same language.
llms.contact_text: Questions about an order or a request go through the contact page. The company site, feelbetter.agency, has the concierge app and the long-form journal.
